title: SOC2 triage cribsheet (scratch)
content:
Quick personal cribsheet for triaging incoming SOC2 evidence requests and control gaps. Meant as working notes — messy, short-hand, TODOs + questions to bring to the weekly SOC2 sync. Not authoritative.

PURPOSE / CONTEXT:
- We're in readiness sprint to get control evidence for upcoming auditor review (Jan 2026 window).
- Focus this week: access control evidence (TSC: CC6/CC7 / Security), vendor risk receipts, logging/evidence for deployment pipelines.

QUICK MAPPING (informal)
- TSC:Security -> controls we usually map: IAM policies, MFA enforcement, privileged access review, vuln mgmt, patch cadence, incident response runbooks.
- TSC:Availability -> DR plan, backup tests, capacity/resilience runbooks, SLA metrics from console.
- TSC:Confidentiality -> encryption-at-rest keys, KMS rotation proof, key access logs, contract redaction process.
- TSC:ProcessingIntegrity -> CI test coverage for critical transforms, data validation checks, regression evals (redwood-optimize).

EVIDENCE TYPES WE CAN PRODUCE (quick list)
- Config snapshots: IAM policy JSON, role bindings, Terraform state diff (tagged with date).
- Logs: auth logs (last 90 days), SSO audit exports, KMS access logs (filtered).
- Screenshots: console pages that show settings (timestamp + reporter).
- Tickets: Jira links for policy changes, change approvals, emergency patch tickets.
- Runbooks & drills: Incident postmortem examples, DR test notes, tabletop summary.

OPEN QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS (to escalate)
- KMS rotation proof: do we have an automated artifact showing rotation events? Current KMS console exports are noisy; need Samir to confirm retention window. (JIRA-SEC-319)
- 3rd-party subprocessor list: legal has a fresh list but it lacks contract effective dates. Auditor may ask for contract versions. Ping Alex.
- Pipeline logs for infra-as-code: does the audit want run-by-run diffs or just apply-time approvals? We need a canonical example.

SHORT ACTIONS (next 7 days)
- [ ] Ask infra team for a dated Terraform plan+apply record for a recent change (example: autoscaler tweak) — attach PR + run log. Owner: @Samir.
- [ ] Export SSO audit log for Oct-Nov, filter admin events and produce a csv with columns: timestamp, user, action, resource. Owner: Lena.
- [ ] Draft evidence snippet: KMS key usage for model weights export (one pager + log sample). Owner: Alex.
- [ ] Schedule 30-min sync with Legal to get signed subprocessor list and contract IDs. Owner: Lena.
- [ ] Capture screenshot + url of Console -> Settings -> API keys rotation policy. Owner: Lena.

POTENTIAL QUICK GAINS (low lift)
- Use terraform state snapshots stored in s3 (we already have versioning) as evidence of infrastructure drift controls — pick one example and redact sensitive ids.
- Leverage CloudTrail canned export to produce a 90-day admin action report. Need S3 export path + retention proof.

NOTES ON FORMAT AUDITORS LIKE
- Prefer date-stamped artifacts (YYYY-MM-DD) and plain filenames that map to evidence index.
- Short narrative on top of each artifact: what it proves, who signed off, why relevant to control.
- Cross-reference to Confluence policy pages (single source) + Jira ticket showing approval.

RISK / TALKING POINTS (when asked live)
- For dev self-service features: emphasize guardrails (time-limited role sessions, approval workflow) rather than absolute prevention — auditors accept compensating controls if documented.
- On backups: we run app-level snapshots plus cloud provider backups; explain retention + restore drill frequency. Provide a recent restore drill timeboxed note.

AUDIT EVIDENCE INDEX (working example entries)
- evidence_001: IAM-mfa-2025-10-30.csv  -> proves org-wide MFA enforcement; attached screenshot policy; Jira: CONFLUENCE-SEC-1423
- evidence_002: terraform-apply-autoscaler-2025-11-02.log -> shows approval, plan, apply records; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/876
- evidence_003: kms-usage-sample-2025-10.csv -> KMS decrypt events for model export; notes: redacted instance ids; owner: Alex

COMMUNICATION / WHO TO TAG
- Slack channels: #sec-compliance, #infra-ops, #legal-privacy.
- People: @Samir (infra), @Alex (platform security), @Maya (GTM contact for customer inquiries), Legal: legal+contracts.

SHORT TERM MEETING AGENDA (for weekly SOC2)
- 5m: quick wins + blockers
- 10m: owner updates on evidence items from the action list
- 10m: auditor Qs we anticipate and who will draft responses
- 5m: next actions + deadlines

FREEFORM THOUGHTS / RUBBISH (brain dump)
- Might be worth generating a small script that pulls cloudtrail + filter and formats csv with the headers auditors like. Could save repeated manual exports. Low lift for infra eng.
- Consider labeling evidence files with prefix: "SOC2-2025-<control>-<shortdesc>-<date>.pdf" for easy index automation.

REFERENCES / LINKS (internal)
- Confluence policy (draft): CONFLUENCE-SEC-1423
- Jira: JIRA-SEC-319 (KMS rotation), JIRA-OPS-701 (terraform evidence request)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/876

NEXT STEPS: I will collect SSO export, ping infra for terraform logs, and schedule legal sync. Bring these to Thursday SOC2 working session.

— L.P.

(END OF SCRATCH)
